subject: Nimbus Analytics — Post-call MAP & stakeholder decision playbook
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Danielle Ross <danielle.ross@nimbusanalytics.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Discovery + next steps (MAP draft attached)

Hi Danielle — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call (so we all have the same view):

Pain points you shared:
- High per-token cost on current provider, variable latency during peak ET hours.
- Strict data residency and audit requirements for inference logs.
- Need to run a limited pilot that mirrors production traffic patterns (chat + reranking).

Primary goals:
- Reduce inference unit cost by ~35% for chat workloads while keeping P95 latency under 300ms.
- Demonstrate parity on answer quality for top-3 intents within 3 weeks of pilot start.
- Capture audit logs and KMS-based key control during pilot.

Proposed mutual action plan (attached: Nimbus-MAP-v1.pdf):
- Week 0 (sign): SOW + access to staging VPC + baseline metrics collection.
- Weeks 1–2 (pilot infra): deploy dedicated inference pool, integrate KMS, run smoke tests.
- Weeks 3–4 (pilot run): traffic replay + live sampling, weekly quality evals.
- Week 5 (decision): final report, recommendation, pricing proposal for production.

Stakeholders you mentioned on the call: Danielle (AI Product), Jorge (Security), Priya (Procurement). Can you confirm Jorge and Priya's emails so I can include them on the MAP?

Requested next steps from our side:
1) I’ll share a consolidated MAP + SOW draft by EOD tomorrow.
2) Vivek will include a short pilot runbook (hardware, expected throughput, quantization profile).
3) Please confirm decision committee and a target date for the production go/no-go decision.

Attachment: Nimbus-MAP-v1.pdf (3 pages)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Danielle Ross <danielle.ross@nimbusanalytics.com>

Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:35:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Discovery + next steps (MAP draft attached)

Thanks Stephanie — helpful summary. A few clarifications and items from our side: 

1) Stakeholders: Jorge Martinez (jorge.martinez@nimbusanalytics.com) — security lead; Priya Natarajan (pri...@nimbusanalytics.com) in procurement (procurement@nimbusanalytics.com is the shared inbox). I'll loop them in after we get the initial MAP.

2) Timeline: We like the proposed weeks, but procurement has an internal 21-business-day review once SOW + commercial terms are in. So our decision gate may slip to Week 6 if redlines happen.

3) Pilot traffic: We can provide a 500 req/min replay for 3 hours/day of synthetic peak traffic; would that be sufficient to validate batching and latency profiles?

4) Pricing ask: please include a rough range for pilot budget and a production uplift number so my finance lead has visibility.

I’m fine with a meeting next Thursday (9/16) to review the MAP and SOW.

Danielle

What I need from you by EOD today:
- Vivek: concise pilot runbook (target GPU types, expected throughput, cache strategy, quantization tradeoffs). Keep it one page.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Nimbus MAP — need runbook + QA metrics

Steph / Marissa — quick notes and draft pilot schedule below. I pasted the important bits into this reply for fast review.

Technical notes:
- Hardware: 2x A10G instances (dedicated) for initial pilot cluster; target sustained throughput 450–550 req/min with batching windows at 20–40ms.
- Quantization: start FP16 with pathway to 4-bit Q4f for cost testing; plan only to use int4 for reranking to avoid quality regressions.
- Caching: prefix caching for top-3 frequent prompts (client will provide sample set). Expected token savings 18–23%.
- Observability: we’ll ship token-level traces + steamed audit events into their S3 with encryption; KMS integration supported.

Pilot schedule (proposal):
- Week 0 (sign): staging VPC access + baseline metric collection (2 days).
- Week 1: infra deploy + KMS + internal smoke test (3 days).
- Week 2: 3-day replay run (3 hours/day) + weekly QA sample on days 2 and 3.
- Week 3: live incremental traffic sampling + final QA; prep decision packet.
- Week 4: decision review + handoff to CS for production sizing.

Attachments referenced: Pilot runbook (1 page) — I’ll add to the Drive folder.

If procurement pushes review into Week 6, we can insert an extended warm-up (additional replay) to produce more evidence for procurement.

Vivek
Staff Systems Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Danielle Ross <danielle.ross@nimbusanalytics.com>, Jorge Martinez <jorge.martinez@nimbusanalytics.com>, procurement@nimbusanalytics.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized MAP & decision playbook — action requested (confirm stakeholders + target decision date)

Hi Danielle / Jorge / Procurement team —

Thanks for confirming stakeholders, Danielle. Attached is the consolidated Mutual Action Plan (Nimbus-MAP-v1.pdf) and a seed SOW (NMB-pilot-sow-draft.docx). Below is the finalized playbook and asks so we can lock dates.

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
- Owners: Stephanie (Redwood AE) — overall coordination; Vivek (Redwood SE) — technical runbook and infra; Marissa (Redwood CS) — QA and acceptance criteria; Danielle (Nimbus) — product lead; Jorge (Nimbus) — security approver; Procurement (Nimbus) — commercial signoff.

Milestones & decision gates:
1) Baseline collection (2 days) — deliverable: baseline latency and cost report. Target: Sep 22–23.
2) Infra deploy + KMS (3 days) — deliverable: staging cluster with KMS keys and audit sink. Target: Sep 24–26.
3) Replay pilot (3 days, 3 hrs/day) — deliverable: throughput and P95 latency report + QA sample results. Target: Sep 28–30.
4) Live sampling & final QA (3 days) — deliverable: final evaluation and recommendation. Target: Oct 1–3.
5) Decision review (1 day) — deliverable: go/no-go + commercial term alignment. Target: Oct 6 (decision committee meeting).

Acceptance criteria (high level):
- Cost: >= 30% unit cost reduction under pilot config.
- Latency: P95 <= 300ms for chat samples at pilot throughput.
- Quality: <= 5% regression on top-3 intent accuracy compared to baseline.
- Security: KMS-based key control + audit logs sent to Nimbus S3.

Ask / action items for Nimbus team:
- Confirm Jorge Martinez and the correct procurement contact by EOD Mon, Sep 13.
- Confirm target decision committee date — proposed Oct 6.
- Share any commercial constraints (contract term, required SLAs) procurement wants us to know up front.

Budget and commercial note: We’ll include a budget range in the SOW draft — high-level expectation for pilot is $12k–$18k (depending on GPU config and replay hours). Production uplift estimate will be provided after pilot results.

Links & artifacts:
- MAP (attached): Nimbus-MAP-v1.pdf
- SOW draft: NMB-pilot-sow-draft.docx
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/98765
- Shared drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEFGhIJk-LmnOPq

If everyone is aligned I’ll book a 30-minute alignment call for Thu, Sep 16 to walk through the MAP and answer procurement questions. Please reply with any edits to the milestones or acceptance criteria.

Thanks — looking forward to moving to pilot.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
